title: THE KIT PISTOL STAYS OFF GUN 1
why: From the review of the four-gun belt, build 4. On the freebie kit the Scav Pistol is in hand and on key 1. Drawing another gun from the backpack while holding it puts the pistol in the backpack, still on key 1, and decision D3 (the guns on keys 1 and 2 go home as gun 1 and gun 2) then made the kit pistol gun 1 at home. The rule of v15.58 is that the kit pistol is kept but never equipped, so taking the kit never changes the gun he goes up with. D3 left it out only while it was in his hands; it now leaves it out in the backpack too.
now: The freebie kit pistol carried out in the backpack is kept but never becomes gun 1 or gun 2.
